question: Clutch time means the last 5 minutes of the 4th quarter or any overtime, when the score is within 5 points. Which team had the best clutch net points (points scored minus points allowed during clutch plays) in the 2022-23 regular season?
answer:
During the 2022-23 regular season, the Miami Heat had the best clutch net points, outscoring opponents by 70 points across 49 games that featured clutch time. Clutch time is defined as any play in the 4th quarter or overtime with 5:00 or less remaining and the score within 5 points going into the play.

| Team | Clutch Games | Points For | Points Against | Net Points | Net Per Game |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Miami (MIA) | 49 | 479 | 409 | +70 | +1.43 |
| Philadelphia (PHI) | 40 | 372 | 312 | +60 | +1.50 |
| New Orleans (NOP) | 32 | 337 | 282 | +55 | +1.72 |
| Sacramento (SAC) | 42 | 497 | 449 | +48 | +1.14 |
| L.A. Lakers (LAL) | 40 | 377 | 335 | +42 | +1.05 |
| New York (NYK) | 44 | 417 | 484 | -67 | -1.52 |
| Detroit (DET) | 32 | 252 | 327 | -75 | -2.34 |

* **Dynamic thresholding:** Because clutch status is evaluated play-by-play, games enter and exit clutch status dynamically, meaning clutch game durations vary.
* **Data limitations:** Scored points are parsed from play-by-play text and can differ slightly from official box scores in roughly 4% of games.
* **Per-game efficiency:** While Miami accumulated the highest total net points (+70 in 49 games), New Orleans was more efficient on a per-game basis, averaging +1.72 net points across 32 games.

args.query:
SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS clutch_games, SUM(clutch_pts_for) AS pts_for, SUM(clutch_pts_against) AS pts_against,
       SUM(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against) AS net_pts,
       ROUND(AVG(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against), 2) AS net_per_game
FROM team_game_clutch
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY net_pts DESC
